description: A Dart class defining an API client for backend communication in a Flutter application. It provides methods for making HTTP GET, POST, PUT, DELETE requests with JSON handling, error handling, and configurable base URL.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class for API errors, including HTTP status code and message.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: Provides HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) with JSON encoding/decoding and error handling.

methods.name: ApiClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the API client with optional HTTP client.

methods.name: _uri
methods.description: Creates a URI with the base URL and optional query parameters.

methods.name: _headers
methods.description: Getter providing standard headers for JSON communication.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified path with optional query parameters.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs a POST request with a JSON-encoded body.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Performs a PUT request with a JSON-encoded body.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request to the specified path.

methods.name: _handleResponse
methods.description: Handles HTTP responses, decoding JSON or throwing exceptions on error.
